about: Where every embedded asset file comes from and on what terms. tests/structure.rs (backrooms) checks that each crates/game/assets/*.bin and textures/*.jpg has an entry, that its fingerprint (FNV-1a 64 of the file, written by cargo xtask assets) matches, that its licence and generator are allowed, and that its sources exist. A generative model (image-to-3D, AI audio) may be used only if it is in allowed_models, which records models whose licence allows commercial use everywhere the game ships; non-commercial weights (AudioGen, MMAudio) and territory-limited ones (Hunyuan3D 2.1) are not allowed.

bodies.bin.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction; the bodies that were people start from MakeHuman's base mesh and targets (CC0 1.0, the MakeHuman team)
bodies.bin.built_with: Blender 5.2.2 LTS headless: skeletons, bodies (MakeHuman's hm08 base and its targets, or metaballs), voxel remesh, displacement, decimation, bone-heat weights, vertex paint; packed by cargo xtask assets creatures
bodies.bin.rebuild: cargo xtask assets creatures [--only …] [--write]; the MakeHuman files and their SHA-1s are in assets/src/creatures/sources.json (fetched once into target/creature-sources/)

creature_meshes.bin.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction
creature_meshes.bin.built_with: the HTML version's pipeline (creatures.py, skinned.py over its rig dumps, creature-pack.mjs), converted byte for byte from its src/creature-meshes.js (fingerprint f8542507bbec07a3) by cargo xtask assets import-js
creature_meshes.bin.rebuild: needs the HTML version's rig dumps (tools/rig-dump.mjs there), not yet ported; see assets/README.md

prop_meshes.bin.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction
prop_meshes.bin.built_with: the HTML version's pipeline (props.py, prop-assemble.mjs), converted byte for byte from its src/prop-meshes.js (fingerprint 9402a16016f4edb5) by cargo xtask assets import-js
prop_meshes.bin.frozen_parts_reason: built before the build was repeatable: their noise came from mathutils.noise.noise_vector, which gives different values in every Blender process. propkit.noise3 replaced it on 2026-10-25, so a rebuild now repeats, but gives these parts new shapes; core_props_head, core_props_tail and props fixtures sample some of them. Rebuild them with --write --rebuild-frozen together with re-recorded fixtures.
prop_meshes.bin.rebuild: cargo xtask assets props [--write]; Blender 5.2.2 reproduces every part but the frozen ones exactly
